title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Process of Recycling Office Paper
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which used office paper is recycled into new paper products. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先花约5分钟分析流程图：识别流程的起点、终点、主要阶段以及各步骤之间的先后关系。写作时，用一段引言改写题目，再用一段或两段概述主要特征（如流程分为几个阶段、哪些步骤涉及人工与机械、哪些涉及化学处理），最后用一段或两段描述具体步骤并做适当比较（如时间、温度、材料变化）。注意使用恰当的被动语态和顺序连接词。不要加入个人观点或解释原因。字数不少于150词。

figure.title: Recycling of Used Office Paper into New Paper Products
steps: Used office paper is collected from offices and delivered to a recycling plant.
The paper is sorted by hand and machine to remove staples, plastic, and other contaminants.
Sorted paper is shredded into small pieces to increase surface area.
Shredded paper is mixed with water and chemicals in a pulper to create a pulp slurry.
The pulp is screened and cleaned to remove remaining impurities such as glue and ink particles.
The cleaned pulp is de-inked using air bubbles and then bleached with hydrogen peroxide.
The pulp is spread onto a wire mesh, pressed, and formed into continuous sheets.
The sheets are dried using heated rollers and then smoothed and cut to size.
Finished paper rolls are packaged and distributed to manufacturers for new paper products.
